description: Implementation of a service class for reading and fetching product-to-GL account mapping details in the Fineract accounting module, including methods for different product types and accounting rules.

classes.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to retrieve product to GL account mappings for different product types and accounting rules.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping details for a loan product based on its ID and accounting type.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping details for a savings product based on its ID and accounting type.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches payment type to fund source mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Fetches payment type to fund source mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: fetchFeeToIncomeAccountMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches fee to income account mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchPenaltyToIncomeAccountMappingsForLoanProduct
methods.description: Fetches penalty to income account mappings for a loan product.

methods.name: fetchFeeToIncomeAccountMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Fetches fee to income account mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: fetchPenaltyToIncomeAccountMappingsForSavingsProduct
methods.description: Fetches penalty to income account mappings for a savings product.

methods.name: fetchAccountMappingDetailsForShareProduct
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping details for a share product.

methods.name: fetchPaymentTypeToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Internal method to fetch payment type to fund source mappings based on product type and ID.

methods.name: fetchChargeToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Internal method to fetch charge to income account mappings for loan or savings products.

methods.name: fetchChargeOffReasonMappings
methods.description: Fetches charge-off reason mappings for a product.

methods.name: fetchWriteOffReasonMappings
methods.description: Fetches write-off reason mappings for a product.

methods.name: fetchAdvancedMappingToExpenseAccountData
methods.description: Converts list of mappings to advanced expense account data objects.

methods.name: fetchClassificationMappings
methods.description: Fetches classification mappings for a product based on classification parameter.

methods.name: setAccrualPeriodicSavingsProductToGLAccountMaps
methods.description: Maps accrual periodic savings product mappings to account details.

methods.name: setCashSavingsProductToGLAccountMaps
methods.description: Maps cash savings product mappings to account details.
